section_title: gitlab: GitLab as the forge, read only
none: GitLab is not set up: CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_TOKEN_FILE names no file.
none_todo: Connect GitLab in the setup assistant's forge step, or set CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_TOKEN_FILE and CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_URL.
address_fail: "{given}" is not an address Cleared sends the token to: https, or http on this machine only.
address_todo: Set CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_URL to your GitLab's https address, or leave it out for gitlab.com.
file_ok: The token's file {path} is this account's, mode 600.
file_relative: CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_TOKEN_FILE is {path}, not an absolute path.
file_link: {path} is a link: Cleared reads only a plain file.
file_open: {path} is mode {mode}: other accounts can read it.
file_unreadable: {path} does not hold one token alone, on one line.
file_todo: Save the token again in the setup assistant's forge step: it writes the file, mode 600.
after_settings: Not asked: the address or the file above fails.
account_ok: GitLab at {address} accepts the token: it acts as @{name}.
account_refused: GitLab refused the token (401): it is wrong, expired or revoked.
account_refused_todo: Make a new personal access token with the api scope and save it in the setup assistant's forge step.
account_forbidden: GitLab answered 403 to the token: the account may be blocked, or an administrator limits its access.
account_forbidden_todo: Ask your GitLab's administrator about the account, then run the doctor again.
account_unreachable: GitLab did not answer within {limit} at {address}.
account_unreachable_todo: Check that this machine reaches {address}, then run the doctor again.
account_status_todo: Check that {address} is your GitLab, then run the doctor again.
after_account: Not asked: GitLab did not accept the token.
scope_ok: The token has the api scope: Cleared can open, comment, close and merge merge requests.
scope_missing: The token lacks the api scope (it has: {scopes}): Cleared cannot open or merge a merge request with it.
scope_todo: Make a new personal access token with the api scope and save it in the setup assistant's forge step.
scope_unsaid: GitLab did not say the token's scopes ({reason}): an older GitLab, or another kind of token.
workspace_refused_todo: Fix the workspace file, then run the doctor again.
projects_none: No service of the workspace is on GitLab.
projects_none_todo: Write forge = gitlab under a service of the workspace file whose repository is on GitLab.
project_ok: {project}: the token holds the role {role} there.
project_role: {project}: the token holds only the role {role} there; Cleared pushes branches and opens merge requests, which needs Developer.
project_role_todo: Give the token's account the role Developer on {project}, or Maintainer to merge into a protected branch.
project_missing: {project} is not seen with this token (GitLab answered {status}).
project_missing_todo: Check the project's path in the workspace file, and that the token's account is a member of {project}.
project_unreachable: GitLab did not answer within {limit} about {project}.
